data: Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.
Magellan is a deep-space orbiter built by Martin Marietta in USA. Radar-mapped 98% of Venus's surface. Mission ended in 1994.
Most complete radar map of Venus — 98% of the surface at ~120-m resolution; first planetary spacecraft launched from the Space Shuttle
First Jupiter orbiter; 8 years of measurements
NASA Discovery polar orbiter — neutron-spectrometer hydrogen finding at both poles 1998; deliberate Shoemaker impact ended mission 1999
Only spacecraft to visit all four giant planets
Longest-lived Mars asset ever — orbiting since 2001-10-24. Gamma-ray + neutron water-ice maps; UHF relay for the surface fleet
Companion orbiter to Viking-1 lander — relay + 50000 surface images at 150-300 m/pixel, the first global Mars map. Operated 1976-1980
